name: Festival Stone of Frostfell
title: Festival Stone of Frostfell
summary: The Festival Stone of Frostfell on a pine ridge (z 178) west of Stonehold, at 69.4N 25.0W. The stone, with its Anniversary glow, is flanked by two 3 m Master's Sentinel candle statues with blue flames. The ridge drops 20-40 m east and west, and a Snowman spawns 120 m north.

landmarks.name: Festival Stone of Frostfell
landmarks.note: Spawn with Anniversary Effect glow above.

site.name: Festival Stone of Frostfell
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer frostfell-festival-stone (on the ridge 14 m west-north-west of the stone, z 178).

shots.standingOrder: Rise 4 m on the ridge 15 m east of the Festival Stone, keeping it centred between its two blue-lit candle sentinels, until the Stonehold valley opens behind it; keep 3.5 m from the shrubs.
shots.notes: Pedestal. The camera rises 4 m on the ridge 15 m east of the stone, keeping it centred between its two blue-flamed Master's Sentinel candles until the Stonehold valley appears behind. The morning sun is behind the lens. The nearest object is a small plant at 3.6 m on a 0.79 m/s move.
